Overview

The GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline orchestrates automated testing, building, and publishing of OpenHands Docker images. The pipeline executes five primary workflows:

  1. ghcr-build.yml - Builds and publishes Docker images (app, runtime, enterprise)
  2. lint.yml - Executes linters on Python and TypeScript code
  3. fe-unit-tests.yml - Runs frontend test suite
  4. lint-fix.yml - Auto-fixes linting issues when triggered
  5. stale.yml - Manages stale issues and PRs

Related documentation: Local development workflow (page 11.1), Docker image building strategy (page 11.2), pre-commit hooks (page 11.4).

The containers/build.sh script invokes docker buildx build with:

  • Build args: OPENHANDS_BUILD_VERSION from sanitized GITHUB_REF_NAME

The job skips execution if github.ref starts with refs/tags/ext-v (external extension tags).

Job: ghcr_build_runtime

Builds runtime images using 8vCPU runner (blacksmith-8vcpu-ubuntu-2204):

Title: Runtime Image Build Pipeline

The runtime_build.py module invokes prep_build_folder() which:

  1. Copies openhands/ source to containers/runtime/code/openhands/
  2. Copies skills/ directory to containers/runtime/code/skills/
  3. Copies pyproject.toml and poetry.lock to containers/runtime/code/
  4. Generates Dockerfile from Jinja2 template Dockerfile.j2

The build.sh --dry command outputs docker-build-dry.json:

Tag naming follows the pattern:

  • oh_v{version}_{lock_hash}_{source_hash} (source tag)
  • oh_v{version}_{lock_hash} (lock tag)
  • oh_v{version}_{versioned_tag} (versioned tag, SCRATCH builds only)

Where:

  • lock_hash = get_hash_for_lock_files() from pyproject.toml + poetry.lock
  • source_hash = get_hash_for_source_files() from openhands/ directory
  • versioned_tag = get_tag_for_versioned_image() from base image name

Forked PRs upload artifacts instead of pushing:

Stale Issue Management Workflow (stale.yml)

Scheduled workflow using actions/stale@v9:

The workflow processes 300 issues/PRs per run. Items become stale after 40 days of inactivity and close 10 days later (50 days total). Labels roadmap, backlog, and app-team exempt items from staleness.

Dockerfile Template Macros

The Jinja2 template Dockerfile.j2 defines macros conditionally included based on build_from_scratch and build_from_versioned flags:

{% macro setup_base_system() %} openhands/runtime/utils/runtime_templates/Dockerfile.j215-144

  • Installs: wget, curl, git, jq, tmux, build-essential, ripgrep, ffmpeg
  • Installs Node.js 22 and Python 3.12
  • Creates openhands user (UID 1000) with passwordless sudo
  • Creates /openhands directories

{% macro install_docker() %} openhands/runtime/utils/runtime_templates/Dockerfile.j298-136

  • Adds Docker GPG key and repository

{% macro install_dependencies_user() %} openhands/runtime/utils/runtime_templates/Dockerfile.j2248-262

{% macro install_dependencies_root() %} openhands/runtime/utils/runtime_templates/Dockerfile.j2195-245

  • Installs Playwright browsers to /opt/playwright-browsers (if enable_browser=true)
  • Sets PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH environment variable

Workflow Optimization

Concurrency Control

Group resolution:

  • PRs: "Docker-refs/pull/123/head" (shared across commits to same PR)
  • Main: "Docker-1234567890" (unique per run)

When a new commit pushes, cancel-in-progress: true terminates the previous run in the same group.

Sources: .github/workflows/ghcr-build.yml23-25 .github/workflows/lint.yml14-16

Conditional Execution

Jobs use if conditions for conditional execution:

JobConditionPurpose
ghcr_build_app!(github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/ext-v'))Skip for external extension tags
ghcr_build_enterprisegithub.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork != trueSkip for forked PRs
enterprise-previewgithub.event_name == 'pull_request' && contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'deploy')Only when PR has deploy label
update_pr_descriptiongithub.event_name == 'pull_request' && !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork && github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]'Skip for forks and Dependabot
lint-fix-frontendgithub.event.label.name == 'lint-fix'Only when PR labeled lint-fix
stalegithub.repository == 'OpenHands/OpenHands'Only in main repository (not forks)
